title: galium anglicum subsp. divaricatum
intro: Galium anglicum subsp. divaricatum, commonly known as English bedstraw, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the madder family (Rubiaceae). This plant is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include alleviating digestive issues, such as diarrhea and dyspepsia. The health benefits of English bedstraw include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antispasmodic actions, making it a potential remedy for various ailments. The bioactive constituents of Galium anglicum subsp. divaricatum include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic properties.
